description: This file defines React components for a cache health monitoring dashboard, including detailed views of cache status, error handling, and Redis-specific information. It includes UI components like tabs, buttons, and error fields with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: deepParse
methods.description: Helper function to safely parse JSON strings, returning the original input if parsing fails.

methods.name: TableClickableErrorField
methods.description: React component displaying a label and value with expand/collapse and copy-to-clipboard features.

methods.name: HealthCheckDetails
methods.description: React component displaying detailed cache health response, handling errors and extracting Redis info.

methods.name: CacheHealthTab
methods.description: Main React component rendering the cache health monitoring UI, including run button and response display.
